Which Round Table Conference held in London was attended by Sarojini Naidu and Muhammad Iqbal?
o: First and Second Round Table Conferences
x:
The Second Round Table Conference was held in London from September to December 1931. It was significant because: • Mahatma Gandhi attended as the sole representative of the Indian National Congress. • Sarojini Naidu participated as one of the representatives. • Muhammad Iqbal represented the Muslim community. The conference discussed constitutional reforms, minority representation and the future political structure of India. However, it failed to produce a consensus, particularly on communal representation.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).
